public.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
public.description: Return the longest contiguous palindromic substring of text. Break ties by the smallest starting index. Text contains 0 to 500 ASCII letters or digits. The empty string returns an empty string.
hints: Expand around both odd and even palindrome centers.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Expansion finds the longest palindrome for every center. Scan centers from left to right and replace only on strict improvement to preserve the earliest tie. O(n squared) time.
